summary: Deschutes NF volcano lookout 16 mi WSW of Bend: 1913 alidade on a stump, a 1930s cab (or 1948 one-room house per Rex), removed in the 1970s; no site remains described.

facts.status_note: Removed in the 1970s per the register; firelookout.com says destroyed then; Wikipedia says abandoned in the 1970s and later removed

staffing.status: lookout-fireman W.T. Curtis recorded in 1948; no later staffing in these sources

access.note: Wikipedia describes a hiking route up the southwest flank to the summit; no source read gives closures or land-status limits

visit.trail_note: Wikipedia describes a route up the volcano's southwest flank to the top; no trailhead or distance given

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register and firelookout.com describe a two-story L-4 cab from the 1930s. Rex's page quotes 1948 Bend Bulletin items for a new one-room house and says the headquarters were in a tent-house at that time. The sources do not settle whether the 1930s cab stood, so the story reports both.

The register and firelookout.com date removal or destruction to the 1970s. Rex's page records the firefinder and portable gear leaving in September 1968 and the lookout no longer being needed. These may describe equipment and structure separately, so the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: No source describes what remains on the summit today. The 1930s two-story cab and the 1948 one-room house conflict or overlap; the editor may want the infobox to say which house is meant. The brief's height_m 4.9 has no source here and is proposed for removal. Wikipedia is used only as a lead and its tower claim is not independently confirmed. The 1948 Bend Bulletin items are quoted via Rex's page, not the newspaper. The brief's kind two_story is kept on the strength of the register. The register's photo captions were not read. Access 'public' rests on Wikipedia's route description alone; check the land status before publishing.
